v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: Let us adore God * Our Saviour.

la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.la: Deus, ne síleas a me, remítte mihi.
v.en: O Lord, be not thou silent, forgive me.

r.la: Quóniam íncola ego sum apud te et peregrínus.
r.en: For I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner.

text.en: Overthrow, O Lord, * them that fight against me.

text.la: Restítue ánimam meam * a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.
text.en: Rescue, O Lord, * my soul from their malice.

text.la: Exsúrge, Dómine, * et inténde iudício meo.
text.en: Arise, O Lord, * and be attentive to my judgment.

text.la: Noli æmulári * in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.
text.en: Envy not * the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

text.la: Brácchia peccatórum * conteréntur, confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
text.en: The arms of the wicked * shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

text.la: Ne in ira tua * corrípias me, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * do not chastise me in thy wrath.

text.la: Inténde in adiutórium meum, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.

text.la: Ámove, Dómine, * a me plagas tuas.
text.en: Remove, O Lord, * thy scourges from me.

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

benedictio.la: Deus Pater omnípotens sit nobis propítius et clemens.
benedictio.en: May God the Father Omnipotent, be to us merciful and clement.

source.en: Lesson from the book of Ezekiel

text.la: 1 Et dixit ad me: Fili hóminis, quodcúmque invéneris, cómede: cómede volúmen istud, et vadens lóquere ad fílios Israël. 2 Et apérui os meum, et cibávit me volúmine illo: 3 Et dixit ad me: Fili hóminis, venter tuus cómedet, et víscera tua complebúntur volúmine isto quod ego do tibi. Et comédi illud, et factum est in ore meo sicut mel dulce. 4 Et dixit ad me: Fili hóminis, vade ad domum Israël, et loquéris verba mea ad eos.
text.en: 1 And he said to me: Son of man, eat all that thou shalt find: eat this book, and go speak to the children of Israel. 2 And I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that book. 3 And he said to me: Son of man, thy belly shall eat, and thy bowels shall be filled with this book, which I give thee. And I did eat it: and it was sweet as honey in my mouth. 4 And he said to me: Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and thou shalt speak my words to them.

body.la: A fácie furóris tui, Deus, conturbáta est omnis terra:
body.en: Before the face of thine anger, O God, the whole earth is troubled;

refrain.la: Sed miserére, Dómine, et ne fácias consummatiónem.
refrain.en: But Thou, O Lord, have mercy, and make not an end utterly.

verse.la: Dómine, Dóminus noster, quam admirábile est nomen tuum!
verse.en: Lord our Ruler, how excellent is thy Name in all the earth!

benedictio.la: Christus perpétuæ det nobis gáudia vitæ.
benedictio.en: May Christ to all His people give, for ever in His sight to live.

text.la: 5 Non enim ad pópulum profúndi sermónis et ignótæ linguæ, tu mítteris ad domum Israël; 6 Neque ad pópulos multos profúndi sermónis et ignótæ linguæ, quorum non possis audíre sermónes; et, si ad illos mitteréris, ipsi audírent te; 7 Domus autem Israël nolunt audíre te, quia nolunt audíre me; omnis quippe domus Israël attríta fronte est, et duro corde. 8 Ecce dedi fáciem tuam valentiórem faciébus eórum, et frontem tuam duriórem fróntibus eórum: 9 Ut adamántem et ut sílicem dedi fáciem tuam; ne tímeas eos neque métuas a fácie eórum, quia domus exásperans est.
text.en: 5 For thou art not sent to a people of a profound speech, and of an unknown tongue, but to the house of Israel: 6 Nor to many nations of a strange speech, and of an unknown tongue, whose words thou canst not understand: and if thou wert sent to them, they would hearken to thee. 7 But the house of Israel will not hearken to thee: because they will not hearken to me: for all the house of Israel are of a hard forehead and an obstinate heart. 8 Behold I have made thy face stronger than their faces: and thy forehead harder than their foreheads. 9 I have made thy face like an adamant and like flint: fear them not, neither be thou dismayed at their presence: for they are a provoking house.

body.la: Civitátem istam tu circúmda, Dómine: et Angeli tui custódiant muros eius.
body.en: Fence Thou this city; O Lord, and let thine angels keep the walls thereof.

refrain.la: Exáudi, Dómine, pópulum tuum cum misericórdia.
refrain.en: O Lord, hearken unto thy people with mercy.

verse.la: Avertátur furor tuus, Dómine, a pópulo tuo et a civitáte sancta tua.
verse.en: O Lord, let thine anger be turned away from thy people, and from thine holy city.

benedictio.la: Ignem sui amóris accéndat Deus in córdibus nostris.
benedictio.en: May the Spirit's fire Divine in our hearts enkindled shine.

text.la: 10 Et dixit ad me: fili hóminis, omnes sermónes meos, quos ego loquor ad te, assúme in corde tuo et áuribus tuis audi; 11 Et vade, ingrédere ad transmigratiónem, ad fílios pópuli tui, et loquéris ad eos; et dices eis: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Si forte áudiant et quiéscant. 12 Et assúmpsit me spíritus, et audívi post me vocem commotiónis magnæ: Benedícta glória Dómini de loco suo; 13 Et vocem alárum animálium percutiéntium álteram ad álteram, et vocem rotárum sequéntium animália, et vocem commotiónis magnæ.
text.en: 10 And he said to me: Son of man, receive in thy heart, and hear with thy ears, all the words that I speak to thee: 11 And go get thee in to them of the captivity, to the children of thy people, and thou shalt speak to them, and shalt say to them: Thus saith the Lord: If so be they will hear and will forbear. 12 And the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great commotion, saying: Blessed be the glory of the Lord, from his place. 13 And the noise of the wings of the living creatures striking one against another, and the noise of the wheels following the living creatures, and the noise of a great commotion.

body.la: Genti peccatríci, pópulo pleno peccáto miserére,
body.en: O Lord God! have mercy upon

refrain.en: The sinful nation, upon the people laden with iniquity.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Deus, refúgium nostrum et virtus: adésto piis Ecclésiæ tuæ précibus, auctor ipse pietátis, et præsta; ut, quod fidéliter pétimus, efficáciter consequámur.
text.en: O God, our Refuge and Strength, Who art the author of all godliness, be ready, we beseech thee, to hear the devout prayers of thy Church, and grant that those things which we ask faithfully, we may obtain effectually.

office.title: Feria Tertia infra Hebd XXII post Octavam Pentecostes I. Novembris
